title: Perfil de las emprendedoras en México y sus principales motivos y retos
summary: Las emprendedoras en México enfrentan retos adicionales frente a los hombres, como responsabilidades de cuidado y acceso al financiamiento. El análisis perfila sus motivaciones y expectativas de crecimiento.

title: Amazon closes in on $7.5bn deal to buy AI start-up Decart
summary: Amazon is closing in on a $7.5bn deal to buy AI start-up Decart. The acquisition would help AWS compete with Nvidia in the race for computing power.

title: California Nvidia Probe Covers Potential Criminal Law Violations
summary: California's probe into whether Nvidia illegally sold advanced chips to China and misled investors also covers potential criminal violations of state law. The scope raises the stakes for the chipmaker.

title: ¿Tu aseguradora no quiere pagarte? La indemnización podría calcularse después del juicio
summary: Una jurisprudencia de la SCJN establece que la cuantificación definitiva de una indemnización de seguros puede realizarse después del juicio. Esto aplica cuando determinar el monto requiere valoraciones técnicas especializadas.

title: Análisis del Presupuesto de Egresos de la Federación 2027
summary: La Cámara de Diputados aprobó un PEF 2027 de 10.64 billones de pesos, 1.3% real más que en 2026. El análisis examina si los ingresos previstos (unos 9.15 billones sin financiamiento) bastarán para cumplir la meta de déficit e impulsar el crecimiento.

title: Goldman’s SpaceX Pitch Helps Solve AI Debt Puzzle: Credit Weekly
summary: Goldman Sachs spent more than a year working on how to finance AI chips without wrecking corporate balance sheets. Its SpaceX pitch offers a template for solving the AI debt puzzle.

title: Wall Street Asks What Can Save AI Trade After Anthropic Wipeout
summary: The stock market has had a tough month, hit by the ouster of Jensen Huang from Nvidia and the Democrats' decisive midterm victory. Wall Street is now asking what could revive the AI trade after Anthropic's post-IPO wipeout.

title: Anthropic Makes Its Public Market Debut
summary: Anthropic's landmark IPO tested investor appetite for frontier AI and gave the company fresh capital for its enormous computing needs, as OpenAI weighs its own path to public markets. The segment also covers turmoil at Nvidia after Jensen Huang's departure.

title: China Plans to Strengthen AI Token Standards in Computing Push
summary: China's National Data Administration will improve standards for measuring and billing AI tokens and for quality assessment. Beijing is guiding the development of the fast-growing industry.

title: The AI cyber threat is already here
summary: The FT argues AI-enabled cyber threats are no longer hypothetical but already here. Based on the headline and blurb only, the piece frames recent incidents as just the start.

title: Reactivar Sinaloa comienza por recuperar a sus MiPyMEs
summary: Un vicepresidente de Coparmex argumenta que la recuperación económica de Sinaloa depende de rescatar a sus micro, pequeñas y medianas empresas. Señala el efecto en cadena sobre familias, trabajadores y proveedores cuando cierran.

title: Anthropic Researcher Claims to Solve Riemann Problem With Claude
summary: An Anthropic researcher says he used Claude to solve a famous number theory problem that has stumped mathematicians for more than 150 years. The claim comes on the heels of Anthropic's record-breaking IPO.

title: El peso mexicano pierde 3,5% en la semana y toca los MXN$19,19, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025
summary: El peso mexicano perdió 3,5% en la semana y tocó MXN$19,19 por dólar, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025. La depreciación responde a expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de Banxico y la Fed.

title: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith on AI Usage in the Workplace
summary: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith discusses AI valuations and adoption, citing research that puts AI use for workplace tasks below 4%. She contrasts that figure with the widespread chatbot use seen in her own circle.

title: Nvidia faces US regulator’s probe into its accounting
summary: The SEC is investigating Nvidia's accounting. The probe adds to the chipmaker's difficulties following Jensen Huang's resignation.

title: US tech stocks plunge into bear market in worst week since Covid-19 crisis
summary: US tech stocks fell into a bear market in their worst week since the Covid-19 crisis. Shares in Anthropic and Nvidia tumbled as fears over the AI spending boom gripped Wall Street.

title: Wall Street sufre ola de ventas: S&P 500 y Dow Jones entran en corrección y Nasdaq se desploma
summary: El S&P 500 perdió 3,7% y acumula una caída de 10% desde su máximo, entrando en corrección junto con el Dow Jones, mientras el Nasdaq se desplomó. La jornada estuvo marcada por la caída de Anthropic (ANT), el retroceso de Nvidia y dudas sobre la rentabilidad de las inversiones en IA.

title: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
summary: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler, according to people familiar with the matter. The deal would rank among the largest ever in the cybersecurity sector.

title: México oficializa control a inversiones extranjeras y abre incertidumbre por adquisiciones
summary: México oficializó un mecanismo de control a las inversiones extranjeras. La medida abre incertidumbre sobre cómo se evaluarán futuras adquisiciones en el país.

title: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
summary: AI coding startup Cognition AI is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after its last round. The talks show continued investor appetite for AI agent companies despite market jitters.

title: Donald Trump threatens ‘tremendous’ tax on data centres built outside US
summary: Donald Trump threatened a 'tremendous' tax on data centres built outside the US. He framed the move as a fight to prevent Beijing from taking the lead in AI.

title: Globant amplía programa de recompra de acciones: la carta de Migoya a accionistas
summary: El negocio de IA de Globant duplicó en un trimestre su ritmo anualizado de facturación, a US$106,6 millones. La empresa ampliará su recompra de acciones a US$250 millones, la mayor de su historia, con ingresos trimestrales de US$611,1 millones.

title: US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets
summary: Measures of perceived US credit risk hit their highest in nearly eight months, and the cost of insuring big tech firms' debt against default jumped. The wobbling AI trade drove global volatility and a rush into safe havens.

title: Comienzan las ofertas para comprar Axtel y su controladora
summary: Arrancó el proceso de ofertas para adquirir Axtel y su empresa controladora. La operación es una de las transacciones corporativas relevantes en México en curso.

title: Hotel Tepoztlán / Taller Carlos Marín + Pasquinel Studio
summary: Taller Carlos Marín and Pasquinel Studio designed a hotel between Tepoztlán and Amatlán, Morelos, with four buildings integrated into the topography and views of the Tepozteco. The site was previously an abandoned plot with natural vegetation.

title: ¿En quién confiamos cuando confiamos en una IA?
summary: Expansión plantea la pregunta de en quién depositamos realmente nuestra confianza al confiar en una inteligencia artificial. El texto reflexiona sobre la confianza y la gobernanza en el uso de IA.

title: Hotel Casa Zamná Tulum / Studio Arquitectos
summary: Casa Zamná is a boutique hotel on a 5,160 m² beachfront plot in Tulum designed by StudioArqs. It blends contemporary design with traditional regional elements facing the Caribbean.

title: Mexican Studio COLECTIVO C733 Named First Recipient of the Siza Award for Public Architecture
summary: Mexico-based COLECTIVO C733 was named the inaugural recipient of the Serralves Foundation's Siza Award for public architecture. The prize recognizes architectural generosity and public-space engagement.

title: Emerging Stocks Enter Bear Market as AI Triggers Global Selloff
summary: The MSCI emerging-market stock index entered a bear market, falling for a seventh day in its longest losing streak since 2024. The decline came amid a global selloff in tech shares.

title: Anthropic soars, but it may soon be back, cap in hand
summary: The Economist describes Anthropic's listing as the biggest IPO of all time. It argues the offering is only a start, suggesting the company may soon need to return to investors for more capital.
